title: BlockFlow workflow export file
description: What Import accepts: {format, version, workflows[]} or a single workflow object. Generated by scripts/guide.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Leave it out or use 2. Files with 1 are migrated on import.

enabled.description: Ignored on import: imported workflows are always off.

config.description: Start here when you press Run, with some starting values (also defaults for Run Workflow).
Start the flow on a schedule, or delay it when placed after another block.

seconds.description: Under 30 seconds the extension keeps its background worker awake to fire on time (Chromium). 30 seconds or more uses browser alarms. After another block: waits up to 600 s inside the run; longer delays continue as a new run.

repeat.description: Only used when this block starts the flow. After another block it always fires once.

config.description: Start the flow at set times: daily at 09:00, on weekdays, every hour, every N minutes.

at.description: For "day". Local time of this computer.

days.description: For "day": every day, weekdays, weekends, or names: mon, wed, fri.

minutes.description: For "N minutes". Runs on the clock (:00, :15, :30…).

config.description: Start when you open a matching page (in any tab). That tab becomes "main".

url.description: Plain text = the URL contains it; * any part between slashes; ** anything; /…/ regex.

config.description: Add an item to the right-click menu that starts the flow on that page.
Fire when the text of a part of a web page changes.

intervalSeconds.description: Only used when this block starts the flow. After a Timer, the Timer decides. Under 30 seconds keeps the background worker awake.

reload.description: Needed to see server-side changes. Turn off for pages that update themselves.

emitOnFirstRead.description: Off = the first read just records the starting value.

config.description: Open a web page, and remember the tab for the next blocks.

url.description: Use {{name}} to insert a value from the previous block.

tab.description: Later blocks find the tab by this name. Use another name (e.g. "admin") for a second tab.

active.description: Off = open quietly in the background.

config.description: Go to a URL, back, forward, or reload, in a tab of this run.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Catch a new tab or window the page opened, and name it for the next blocks.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Wait until the page downloads a file (an export, a report) and get its name, size and type. Can read CSV / JSON / text files.

url.description: Empty = the first download. Plain text: the address or file name contains it; * and /regex/ as in Wait For.

read.description: Extensions cannot open files on disk, so the file is fetched again from its address (with the site's cookies). Fine for exports; a link that makes a new file each time gives that new file.

dataset.description: CSV rows, or a JSON list, replace this dataset.

tab.description: The tab that starts the download. Needed only to read files the page made itself (blob: addresses).

config.description: Read, set, delete or clear a site's cookies, or the page's localStorage / sessionStorage.

name.description: Needed to set or delete. For get: empty = all of them.

url.description: Whose cookies. Empty = the page open in the tab.

domain.description: With a leading dot the cookie is also sent to subdomains.

maxAgeSeconds.description: 0 = a session cookie, gone when the browser closes.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Mock, block or modify page requests for this run. Newest matching rule wins; clear removes the tab’s rules.

rules.description: An array: url pattern, optional method, action, optional status/headers/body/redirectUrl/delayMs. Last matching rule wins. CDP modify changes the outgoing request; browser rules support abort/redirect without delays.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Start or stop recording network metadata as HAR 1.2. Chromium only; bodies, cookies and headers are excluded.

dataset.description: Replaces this dataset with the HAR entries.

filename.description: Leave blank to return the HAR without downloading it.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Chromium only: change viewport/device, locale, timezone, location, media preferences or offline state until this run ends. Location still needs the site’s permission.

width.description: 0 uses the preset/default. Supply width and height together.

userAgent.description: Optional override of the preset user agent. Changes may need a later Navigate/reload.

locale.description: Intl locale and language override; reload for page code that reads language at startup.

longitude.description: Both coordinates required. This does not grant the site geolocation permission.

offline.description: Blocks network requests from this tab. Cleared automatically at run end.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Chromium only: delete cookies, local storage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage and service workers for listed sites. Cookie deletion affects the whole registrable domain, including its subdomains.

origins.description: Explicit HTTP(S) origins only, separated by newlines or commas. Deletion is permanent. Cookies are cleared for each whole registrable domain, including subdomains; other storage is filtered by origin. Never clears history, downloads, passwords or extension data.

config.description: Close a tab this run opened.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Click (or double-click, right-click, hover) an element, with any button, modifier keys and position. Waits until it can be clicked.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

button.description: For "click". Right-click always uses the right button.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the click: Alt, Control, Meta, Shift (joined with + or commas). Empty = none.

position.description: Where to click: x,y in pixels from the element’s top-left corner. Empty = its center.

clickCount.description: Presses in a row (3 = triple click, selects a paragraph). Double-click means at least 2.

force.description: Click even if the element looks hidden, disabled or covered. Only for stubborn pages.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Type a value into a text field. Works with React, Vue and Angular forms.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Fill several fields at once: text, selects, checkboxes. Optionally click submit.

fields.description: Empty values are skipped. Selects take the option text or value; checkboxes take true or false.

submit.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Choose an option in a dropdown (<select>), by its text or value.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

value.description: Several for a multi-select: separate with |

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Tick or untick a checkbox, radio button or switch. Does nothing if it already is.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Press a key or shortcut (Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A…), or insert text at the caret.

key.description: Key names as on the keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, a, Control+A, Shift+Tab, Control+Shift+K. ControlOrMeta+A is ⌘A on a Mac, Ctrl+A elsewhere.

text.description: For "insert text": typed at the caret in one go, like pasting.

locator.description: Focus this element first. Empty = whatever has focus.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Drag an element onto another one: sortable lists, kanban cards, sliders, drop targets.

from.description: The element to pick up (a card, a list item, a slider handle).

to.description: The element to drop it on (another item, a column, a spot on the slider track).

fromPosition.description: x,y in pixels from the top-left corner of "Drag this". Empty = its center.

toPosition.description: x,y in pixels from the top-left corner of "Drop on". Empty = its center.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the drag: Alt, Control, Meta, Shift.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Focus, blur, clear, scroll into view, or dispatch an event (click, input, a custom event) on an element.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

eventType.description: For "dispatch an event". Bubbles, cancelable and composed.

detail.description: For "dispatch an event". Built-in types (click, keydown, input, focus, drag…): the event’s properties. Other types are a CustomEvent and this is its event.detail.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Choose a file for a file input or drop it on a drop zone, without the file dialog: text you write, a file from a URL, or base64 data.

locator.description: The <input type="file"> (hidden ones work too) or its label; with "drop zone", the area files are dropped on.

data.description: For "base64 data": base64 or a data: URL, usually {{body64}} from HTTP Request with "Response as: base64".

filename.description: Empty with a URL = the name in the URL.

mime.description: For "text" and "base64 data" ({{mime}} after HTTP Request; a data: URL brings its own). With a URL the server says.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Scroll to the bottom, top or an element; or keep scrolling until no more content loads.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Answer alert / confirm / prompt boxes automatically, or read what they said.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Wait until an element appears or goes, some text shows, the URL changes, or the page settles.

locator.description: For the element modes. For text: only look inside this element (optional).

url.description: Plain text: the URL contains it. * matches any part between slashes, ** anything. /…/ is a regular expression. Also the request address for the network modes.

method.description: For the network modes. Empty = any.

captureBody.description: For "a network request finishes". Chrome, Edge, Brave only (debugger permission). Only responses that start after this block starts can be read, so it suits slow or later requests.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Run your own JavaScript in the page; its return value is saved. Chrome 135+.

code.description: An async function body: use await, read `data`, and `return` a JSON value.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Read a value from a page: text, attribute, class, whether it exists, or how many.

url.description: BlockFlow opens it in its own background tab. Leave empty to read the run's tab instead (see Tab).

tab.description: Used when Page URL is empty: read from this tab of the run (from Open Tab), as it is now, without reloading.

name.description: Only for "an attribute" and "has a class".

config.description: Scrape repeated items (cards, results, rows) into a list of objects.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.description: No fields = each item's text as {text}. Links (href, src) come back as full URLs.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Read an HTML table into a list of rows, keyed by its column headers.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Run "each" on every page of a paged list, clicking Next in between.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Read the page itself: title, meta tags, JSON-LD, or its localStorage / cookies.

key.description: Storage and cookies: one key. Empty = all of them.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Outline of what is on the page (roles, names, a locator for each element), to write steps from or keep with the run.

locator.description: Only this element and what is inside it. Empty = the whole page.

maxLines.description: Long pages are cut here, with a note.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Take a picture of what the tab shows, the whole page, or one element. Shown on the step and in the report.

locator.description: For "one element". It is scrolled into view first.

compare.description: Visual check: the first run keeps the picture as this block's baseline; later runs fail (visual.mismatch) when it looks different. PNG only.

threshold.description: How different a pixel's colour must be to count, 0 to 1 (0.2 like Playwright; 0 = any change).

maxDiffRatio.description: Share of pixels that may differ, 0 to 1 (0.01 = 1%). 0 = none.

mask.description: Parts that change on their own (a clock, an ad): an element locator, or "x, y, width, height" in CSS pixels from the picture's top-left.

region.description: Element or x, y, width, height

updateBaseline.description: Save this run's picture as the new baseline and pass (like Playwright's --update-snapshots). Switch it off again after.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Check that something is true. Fails the run (or just records it, if soft) when it is not.

locator.description: For element checks. For "ARIA snapshot": the part of the page (empty = the whole page).

name.description: The attribute name for "attribute of an element", the CSS property (color, display…) for "CSS value".

value.description: Only for "a value from the data".

operator.description: Not used by the yes/no checks (visible, checked…).

expected.description: For "ARIA snapshot": a template, one line per element, nested by indenting: - heading "Welcome" [level=1], - button /Sign (in|up)/, - listitem: Apples.

soft.description: Soft: record the failure but keep going

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

config.description: Pause until you press Continue: solve a CAPTCHA, type a 2FA code, take a look.
End this path here: as passed, or as failed with a message.
Go one way when a condition is true, another when it is false.

right.description: Ignored by "is empty", "is true" and similar. For a pattern, write /text/i.

config.description: Go one of several ways: the first case that matches the value picks the output, else "default".

cases.description: Each case is an output named after it (letters, digits, "_" and "-"; not "default", "error", "out" or "done"). No match goes to "default". For a pattern, write /text/i.

config.description: Repeat the blocks on "each" for every item of a list, then continue from "done".

list.description: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

config.description: Run the blocks on "each" a number of times, or until / while a condition holds, then continue from "done".

left.description: Until / while: rendered at every check against the data the last time ended with ({{iteration}} = times run so far).

config.description: Run another workflow with this data, and continue with what it returns.

workflow.description: Its start blocks receive this data. It does not need to be On.

config.description: Add a value to the data flowing through.
Compute new values with expressions: math, text, lists (sum, sort, pluck…).

values.description: Expressions without {{ }}. See docs/guide for the functions.

config.description: Keep only the list items that match a condition.

list.description: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

left.description: Rendered for each item: {{item.…}} is the item, other {{…}} the data.

config.description: Rows of data you paste in (CSV or JSON), e.g. logins to test one by one.

text.description: CSV with a header row (comma, semicolon or tab), or a JSON list.

config.description: Add rows to a named dataset kept in the browser. See and download it on the Data page.

value.description: An expression: a list adds one row per item, anything else one row. E.g. items, or item inside a For Each. Build objects with Transform first.

config.description: Save a list or a dataset to a CSV or JSON file in Downloads.

value.description: An expression, for "a value from the data".

config.description: Show a desktop notification.
Call an API or webhook and use the response.

headers.description: One per line, as  Name: value

body.description: Sent for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

failOnError.description: Stop the flow on HTTP errors (4xx, 5xx)

config.description: Write a line to the run log, e.g. a value you want to see.

source.description: Node id the data comes from.

target.description: Node id the data goes to.

sourcePort.description: Output of the source: out (default), true/false (If), error, each/done (loops)…
